fuente.titulo: Pope appeals for dialogue in Tigray region

titular: Pope Leo XIV calls for end to Tigray violence
bajada: At the General Audience, he urged all sides to halt hostilities and pursue lasting peace
caption: At the close of his General Audience, Pope Leo XIV appealed to all parties in Ethiopia's Tigray region to stop hostilities, saying only sincere commitment can build lasting peace. Source: Vatican News, Sept 30, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet Vatican audience hall with a simple wooden cross on a stand; a pope figure in white stands at a podium in the upper right third, left and center space open and calm.

instagram.texto:
